market_view: Calm regime (VIX 14.4, falling), 10-year yield near its high at 4.72% and a firmer dollar; gold and semis sold off sharply on the last session. A fresh Iran escalation is the only family-level news shock.

oil_gas.catalyst: "U.S. crude oil hits $90 per barrel following latest U.S. attacks against Iran" (CNBC); "Chevron and Exxon Mobil Rise 3% as U.S. Strikes on Iran Push WTI Crude Oil to $86" (24/7 Wall St.); also "Trump says Exxon is 'going in' to Venezuela" (Reuters). A fresh supply shock, the re-entry trigger from the previous note; the last close (WTI 83.4, XOM +0.17%) predates it, so only part may be priced.
oil_gas.reasoning: New supply shock from renewed US strikes on Iran reverses last week's de-escalation; XOM is 8.6% below its high with low volatility and a Venezuela angle. Risk: part of the jump already happened and geopolitical spikes fade, hence only a small edge.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold fell 2.9% and NEM 3.3% in a day with yields and the dollar rising; "Here's Why Gold Price Is Falling Again" (Forbes) is a restatement of the move. NEM is up 37% in 20 days. No named, unpriced catalyst.

chips.reasoning: NVDA fell 4.6% with the semiconductor ETF -3.5%; no NVDA-specific headline and no post-results information beyond price. The previous note required a catalyst; none appeared.

pharma.reasoning: "FDA approves new use of popular diabetes drug" (Action News 5) does not name Lilly or a drug, so it cannot be tied to LLY. No LLY-specific catalyst.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is flat to slightly down and FCX is up 22% in 20 days; headlines are small-cap or non-FCX items (copper foil, Corcel placement, BT copper sale). No FCX-specific catalyst.

would_change_my_mind: A de-escalation in Iran (WTI back below 83) would remove the oil long; an NVDA-specific or export-control catalyst, or a named Lilly event, would open those longs.

handoff.what_changed: US strikes on Iran pushed oil to $86-90 and lifted XOM and CVX about 3% per headlines, a fresh supply shock, so XOM is bought. Gold, miners and semis fell sharply on the last close (gold -2.9%, NVDA -4.6%) with no named catalyst.

oil_gas.why: Fresh Iran supply shock (WTI $86-90 headlines) plus Exxon Venezuela news.

gold_miners.why: Gold falling on higher yields and dollar; no catalyst.

pharma.why: FDA headline does not name Lilly; no LLY catalyst.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX-specific catalyst; FCX up 22% in 20 days.
